reference.ownership: supervisor-owned; repair agents must not edit it, because capability recall divides by it
reference.note: Deliberately not scraped from the live product: it changes underneath us, scraping raises compliance questions, and image search returned unusable results. A frozen spec is both stable and machine-checkable.

build.known_warning: single chunk >500kB (pre-existing, not introduced by this release)

security_group_rule_editing.after: add/edit/remove with AWS named rule types

recently_visited_tracking.after: updates on navigation, observable in state_diff

security_group_rule_display.after: protocol and port resolved from either field name

route_sweep.method: in-browser navigation with per-route error-boundary and global-error reset

end_to_end_mutation.scenario: POST baseline -> navigate /vpc/vpcs -> create VPC via UI -> read /go
end_to_end_mutation.result: initial 2 VPCs, current 3 VPCs, state_diff keys = ['vpc'], no noise

trademark_sweep.method: rendered innerText across 27 routes in a live browser, not source grep
trademark_sweep.note: Source-only grep missed these entirely: they live in dataManager.js seed data and only appear once rendered into IAM, billing and CloudWatch tables.

structural_conformance.method: live DOM measurement in a browser against the frozen reference layout block
structural_conformance.result: all render an <h1> page title at 24px/700; top nav 48px on #0f141a; breadcrumb present; body 14px Open Sans
structural_conformance.note: Replaces screenshot diffing, which stayed blocked for want of a compliant capture corpus. DOM measurement against a frozen spec is deterministic and reproducible where pixel diffing is neither.

workflow_step_parity.method: each workflow walked end to end against a live server; completion asserted from /go current_state, never from the UI success toast

runtime_parity.note: Tasks run against vite preview, not the dev server. The contract is now run against both.

measured: design token conformance to pinned Cloudscape values (11 tokens)
page-title structure and scale across 22 routes in a live browser
global chrome element inventory vs reference (7/7)
workflow step parity, all 6 declared workflows walked end to end and completed at the declared step count
not_measured: pixel-level image comparison against captured screenshots of the live console
authenticity.note: Pixel diffing remains without a compliant capture corpus and is deliberately not the chosen method: DOM measurement against a frozen spec is deterministic, reviewable and reproducible, which pixel diffing against a moving product is not.

residual_risks: A session that never receives POST action=set has no frozen baseline: /go falls back to initial = current, so state_diff stays empty. Real tasks always inject first, so this is latent, but first set_current arguably should freeze a baseline. Not changed here because set_current explicitly promises never to touch .initial.json (golden_patch semantics).

SCHEMA.md still drifts from the code in several places (rdsSnapshots type/storage, billing.taxSettings shape, budgets id, dynamodb tableSize/lsi/ttl, sns subscriptionCount). Documentation-side fix, deliberately out of scope for this release since changing the seed shape would break old tasks.
The state-injection default-fill bug (G1) also exists in shared/secureMockApiPlugin.mjs and therefore likely affects other hub mocks; only this app's vite.config.js was fixed.

fidelity.note: Two scores. The overall one divides partly by inferred requirements and is directional; the sourced-only one divides only by requirements an AWS document or official screenshot names verbatim, and is the defensible figure. Geometric mean so a strong dimension cannot mask a weak one.
